chapter: Tom Albert and Baton Rouge bands
title: Joining Toody Harris's band in Baton Rouge
summary: He moves to singer Toody Harris's band and lists its members.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Then from Toody Johnson I went with Toody Harris. Now he was another singer. He didn't play nothing.

No, I don't think you know him. Toody Harris, he was a big fella too. He was around 200 pounds. Well then Toody Harris' band they had Lyle Thompson on drums. Lurt Fritz on trombone. We had Ed Collins on trumpet. Guy Kelly on trumpet. Joe Robich on piano. Poise Sevilla on guitar. And I was playing clarinet. Clarence Hall was playing tenor saxophone. And a fella by the name of, what was his name? Oh I forget his name. But then he was on alto.
Where was that? No, it was in Baton Rouge. Oh. No, it was in Baton Rouge.
